❗️注意事项:
1、请不要退出晋江app的账号，只要点了退出，或者在其他地方登录了，都要重新抓token。
2、更新token，书籍就要更新目录。
3、【抓包token登录】和【账号登录】二选一，【抓包token登录】的优先级高些，填了【抓包token登录】，就是按【抓包token登录的值】登录

4、登录步骤【设备保护关闭的状态下】：
①填写好账号密码，点击“邮箱验证码”或者“手机验证码”
②填写好验证码，点击“邮箱登录”或者“手机登录”
③想要确认是否成功可以在登录UI里点右上角三点，查看登录头token里是否有值。
④如果弹出提示“请校检验证码”，可尝试填入上一次发送给你验证码。

5、如果邮箱和手机号无法登录，可能是需要过滑动验证码，可尝试先在晋江app里登录一遍后，再在阅读里登录，❗️还是不行就只能抓包token，填写在“抓包token登录”处。

function getloginUrl(){
	let 账号 = result.get("账号");
	let 密码 = result.get("密码");
	let en = encode(密码);
	let id = rd()+":"+java.androidId()+"d4:";
	let sign = encode(Date.now()+"_"+id+"_");
	let loginUrl = `https://app.jjwxc.org/androidapi/login?versionCode=401&loginName=${encodeURIComponent(账号)}&encode=1&loginPassword=${encodeURIComponent(en)}&sign=${encodeURIComponent(sign)}&identifiers=${encodeURIComponent(id)}&autologin=1`;
	return loginUrl
}

function getCode(t){
	try{
		let 验证码 = result.get("验证码");
		let 账号 = result.get("账号");
		let 密码 = result.get("密码");
		
		if(!/^\d{4,}/.test(验证码)){
			let res = 	JSON.parse(java.ajax(getloginUrl()));
	
			if(res.code=="221003"){
				let url = "https://app.jjwxc.org//appDevicesecurityAndroid/getDeviceSecurityCode";
				body = "versionCode=401&username="+encodeURIComponent(账号)+"&checktype="+t;
				option = {
					"method":"POST",
					"body":String(body)
					}
					msg = JSON.parse(java.ajax(url+","+JSON.stringify(option))).data.message;
					
					java.toast(msg);
			}else{
			       if(/\d+_[a-z\d]+/.test(res.token)){
			             java.log("获取到的token值: "+res.token);
			             java.longToast("登录成功"+res.token);
			             LoginToken(res.token)
			       }
			       
			   msg = /校验验证码/.test(res.message)?"请请尝试填入上次发给你的验证码（可能是很久之前的）":res.message;
			   java.log(msg);
					java.toast(msg??res.token)
				}
		}else{
			let lurl = getloginUrl()+"&checktype="+t+"&checkdevicecode="+验证码;
			hhh = java.ajax(lurl);
			let token = JSON.parse(hhh).token??JSON.parse(hhh).message;
			java.longToast(token);
			java.log("获取到的token值: "+token)
			LoginToken(token)
		}
	}catch(e){
		java.log(e)
	}
}

function LoginToken(token){
	let Map = source.getLoginInfoMap()??{};
	let LoginMap = source.getLoginHeaderMap()??{};
	let fl = LoginMap["fl"]??"";
	fl = (fl==""||fl==null)?"9,10":fl;

	let bq = LoginMap["bq"]??"";
	bq = (bq==""||bq==null)?"5":bq;
	
	let at = Map.get("作者列表（作者::作者id 注意添加多个用空格分割）");
	at = (at==""||at==null)?"":at;
	let classCode = LoginMap["classNum"]??"";
	
	let option = {
	 	"token":String(token).replace(/token=|\s|&.*/g,''),
	 	"fl":String(fl),
	 	"bq":String(bq),
	 	"at":java.base64Encode(String(at)),
	 	"classNum":classCode
	 	}
	source.putLoginHeader(JSON.stringify(option))
}


function login(){
	let LoginMap = source.getLoginHeaderMap()??{};
	LoginMap = JSON.stringify(LoginMap);
	let token;
	let t = source.getLoginInfoMap()["抓包token登录"];
	if(/\{"token":"\d+_\w{16,}/.test(LoginMap))token = JSON.parse(LoginMap).token??"";
	if(t!=""&&t!=null)token = t;	
	LoginToken(token);
}

function getCode(type){
	try{
		phone = result.get("账号");
		
	url = "https://www.himehear.com/tjapp/v1/common/verifyCode";
	body={
		"messageType":1,
		"sendType":type,
		"account":String(phone)
		}
		
		option = {
			"method":"POST",
			"body":JSON.stringify(body)
			}
			
			url = url+","+JSON.stringify(option);
			
	  	JSON.parse(java.ajax(url)).code==0?java.toast("验证码发送成功，请注意查收"):java.toast("验证码发送失败，请稍候再试");
	  	
			}catch(e){
				java.log(e)
				}
				
	}


function login(){
	phone = source.getLoginInfoMap().get("账号");
	code = source.getLoginInfoMap().get("验证码");
	url = "https://www.himehear.com/tjapp/v1/user/loginV2";
	
	if(/@/.test(String(phone))){
		loginType = 2
		}else if(/^\d{11}$/.test(String(phone))){
			loginType = 1
			}
	
	body = {
		"verifyCode":String(code),
		"loginType":2,
		"account":String(phone)
		}
		
	option = {
		"method":"POST",
		"body":JSON.stringify(body)
		}
		
	url = url + "," + JSON.stringify(option);
	
	token =JSON.parse(java.ajax(url)).result.token;
	java.log(token);
	
	headers = {
		"token":String(token)
		}
			source.putLoginHeader(JSON.stringify(headers));
	
	}

</js>

        }
        groupQuery();
    } catch (e) {

    }
}

var style_list = [];

<js>
let base_url = getArguments(source.getVariable(), 'server')|| host[0];
let media;
let sources = getArguments(source.getVariable(), 'sources') || getArguments(source.getVariable(), 'source');
let disabled_sources = getArguments(source.getVariable(), 'disabled_sources') || '0';
if (String(key).startsWith("m:") || String(key).startsWith("m：")) {
    media = "漫画"
    key = key.slice(2)
} else if (String(key).startsWith("t:") || String(key).startsWith("t：")) {
    media = "听书"
    key = key.slice(2)
} else if (String(key).startsWith("d:") || String(key).startsWith("d：")) {
    media = "短剧"
    key = key.slice(2)
} else if (String(key).startsWith("x:") || String(key).startsWith("x：")) {
    media = "小说"
    key = key.slice(2)
} else {
    media = getArguments(source.getVariable(), 'tab') || getArguments(source.getVariable(), 'media');
}
if (key.includes('@')) {
    var parts = key.split('@');
    key = parts[0];
    sources = parts[1] || sources;
}
let qtcookie = cookie.getCookie(base_url);
let op = {
    method: "GET",
    headers: {
        cookie: qtcookie
    },
};
op = JSON.stringify(op);
`${base_url}/search?title=${key}&tab=${media}&source=${sources}&page={{page}}&disabled_sources=${disabled_sources},${op}`
</js>

设置正文语言展现形式及翻译优先级
！错误的设置可能导致书源工作不正常
格式：语言展现形式 - 翻译优先级

语言展现形式：
- 日文
- 中文
- 中日
- 日中
翻译优先级：
- 并列（展示所有存在的翻译）
- 优先级序列，写在前面的优先采用，B-百度、Y-有道、G-GPT、S-Sakura，如 `SGYB`

示例（默认值）：中日 - SGYB
示例：中文 - 并列

<js>
function login(){
userInfo=source.getLoginInfoMap()
java.log(userInfo)
UNE=userInfo['手机号码/邮箱号']
PWD=userInfo['密码']
url="{{source.getKey()}}/api/passport/login,";
SU=source.getKey()
body={
  "account": String(UNE),
  "password": String(PWD),
  "mp_token": -1
}
option={
'method': 'POST',
'body': JSON.stringify(body)
}

url=url+JSON.stringify(option)
token=java.ajax(url).match(/"auth_token":"([^"]+)"/)[1]

Cookie={
	"Cookie":"auth_token="+token
	}
header = JSON.stringify(Cookie)
source.putLoginHeader(header)
}
</js>

<js>
  function login() {
  	 const user = String(source.getLoginInfoMap().get("账号"))
    const pw = String(source.getLoginInfoMap().get("密码"))
    let sign = java.md5Encode(`isDevice=Android&password=${pw}&phone=${user}&regDevice=2&key=87ac02d392a8d3566fe7748c8de00af3&secrect=57dcuidu8aa8062bfe8042ea65310669`).toString().toUpperCase()
    let data = JSON.stringify({
      isDevice: "Android",
      password: pw,
      phone: user,
      regDevice: "2",
      sign: sign
    })
    let op = JSON.stringify({
      method: "POST",
      body: data
    })
    let res = java.ajax(`https://api.shaoniandream.com/Login/login,${op}`)
    let $ = JSON.parse(res)
    if($.status != 1) java.toast($.msg)
    java.put("uid",$.data.id)
    source.putLoginHeader(JSON.stringify({
      logintoken: $.data.logintoken
    }))
  	}
</js>

<js>
  let $ = JSON.parse(result)
  let uid = java.get("uid") != "undefined" ? java.get("uid") : "-1"
  let array = []
  $.data.chapterList.forEach((booklet) => {
    array.push({
    	 name: booklet.title,
    	 isv: true
    })
    booklet.chapterList.forEach((chapter) => {
    	 let sign = java.md5Encode(`BookID=${$.data.id}&UserID=${uid}&chapter_id=${chapter.id}&isDevice=Android&isMarket=true&regDevice=2&key=87ac02d392a8d3566fe7748c8de00af3&secrect=57dcuidu8aa8062bfe8042ea65310669`).toString().toUpperCase()
    	 let data = JSON.stringify({
    	   BookID: $.data.id,
    	   UserID: uid,
    	   chapter_id: chapter.id,
    	   isDevice: "Android",
    	   isMarket:"true",
    	   regDevice: "2",
    	   sign: sign
    	 })
      let op = JSON.stringify({
        method: "POST",
        body: data
      })
      array.push({
        name: chapter.title,
        url: "https://api.shaoniandream.com/Booklibrary/readchapter," + op,
        time: java.timeFormat(chapter.release_time_now * 1000),
        vip: chapter.isFree == 1,
        buy: chapter.lock == 1
      })
    })
  })
  array
</js>

function tokenLogin() {
  if (source.getLoginInfoMap() == null) {
    java.toast("未获取到LoginInfoMap，请尝试重新打开登录UI再按一遍")
  }
  putLoginHeader({
    guid: source.getLoginInfoMap()["ywguid"],
    key: source.getLoginInfoMap()["ywkey"]
  })
  java.toast("凭据保存成功")
}

function proxyExcWrapper(fun) {
  try {
    fun()
  } catch (e) {
    java.log(e.toString() + "\n" + e.stack)
  }
}

tocRule.chapterList:
<js>
  let defaultVariable = {
    "volume": {
      "status": false,
      "mode": 1,
      "spacer": " | ",
      "emptyVolumeName": {
        "action": false,
        "replace": "第一卷：默认"
      },
      "onlyOneShow": false
    }
  }
  let variable = (book.getVariable("custom") != "" && book.getVariable("custom") != null) ? book.getVariable("custom") : source.getVariable();
  if(variable != "" && variable != null){
    try{
      variable = JSON.parse(variable);
    } catch(err) {
      java.log(err);
      variable = defaultVariable;
    }
  } else {
    variable = defaultVariable;
  }
  let data = JSON.parse(result).data;
  let list = data.chapterListWithVolume;
  let volume = data.volumeNameList;
  let chapters = [];
  let volume_names = [];
  for(let i in list){
    for(let x in list[i]){
      let c = list[i][x];
      if(variable.volume.status == true && variable.volume.mode == 1 && volume_names.indexOf(c.volume_name) == -1){
        volume_names.push(c.volume_name);
        if(volume.length != 1 || variable.volume.onlyOneShow){
          chapters.push({
            title: ((c.volume_name == "" && variable.volume.emptyVolumeName.action == "replace" && variable.volume.emptyVolumeName.replace) ? variable.volume.emptyVolumeName.replace : c.volume_name),
            isVolume: true
          });
        }
      }
      if(variable.volume.status == true && variable.volume.mode == 2){
        if(c.volume_name == "" && variable.volume.emptyVolumeName.action == "replace" && variable.volume.emptyVolumeName.replace){
          c.title = (c.volume_name == "" ? variable.volume.emptyVolumeName.replace : c.volume_name) + (variable.volume.spacer || " | ") + c.title;
        } else if(volume.length != 1 || variable.volume.onlyOneShow){
          c.title = c.volume_name + (variable.volume.spacer || " | ") + c.title;
        }
      }
      c.url  = `https://fanqienovel.com/reader/${c.itemId}?enter_from=page&force_mobile=0`;
      chapters.push(c);
    }
  }
  chapters
</js>

const headers = JSON.parse(source.header);

const jieqiSearchCss = java.get(`${source.bookSourceUrl}/search.html?search_guard=css`, headers).header('set-cookie');
const cookies = [
    jieqiSearchJs,
    jieqiSearchCss
].join('; ');
headers.Cookie = String(headers.Cookie + '; ' + String(cookies));
cookie.replaceCookie(source.bookSourceUrl, cookies);
const jieqiSearchTicket = java.get(`${source.bookSourceUrl}/search.html?search_guard=redeem&r=${Date.now()}`, headers).header('set-cookie').split('; ')[0];
(page == 1 ?
    '/search.html?searchkey={{key}}' :
    '/search/{{key}}_{{page}}.html') + ',' + JSON.stringify({
    headers: {
        "Cookie": jieqiSearchTicket
    }
});
</js>
